defaults.rationale: Row C only creates the shared contract. Until Row E and Row F wire reader behavior, JSON corpus validation remains current-schema only.
The canonical reader fails loud unless a manifest or table schema version is explicitly listed for this reader surface.

overrides.rationale: Existing frontend manifest reader support covers v1.0 through v1.3; all are additive manifest-shape minors that current-schema validation can interpret.
Existing canonical table reader support covers observation v1.0 and v1.1; v1.1 is additive and current-schema validation remains valid for v1.0 rows.
